prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships
head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9

prOriginalConhecido.nota: No upstream PR: the benchmark head 060cda77 (Régis Hanol, 'FIX: proper handling of group memberships') was committed directly to master on 2015-01-05 and is an ancestor of main (compare = ahead); /commits/<sha>/pulls is empty. The merged code is the benchmark head itself.

tps.bug: Admin remove_member deletes memberships with group.users.delete, which skips GroupUser callbacks, so the cached groups.user_count is never decremented and stays inflated.
tps.evidenciaOpus: The new remove_member calls group.users.delete(user_id) (groups_controller.rb:90). On a has_many :through in Rails 4.1 this delete_all's the GroupUser rows without callbacks, so GroupUser's counter_cache 'user_count' (group_user.rb:2) is not decremented. The old code used Group#remove, which destroyed the records (group.rb:276-278).
tps.evidenciaAstra: The new removal path calls `group.users.delete(user_id)` at app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90, bypassing the destruction callback for the custom `user_count` counter in app/models/group_user.rb:2. The associations at app/models/group.rb:5-8 do not configure that custom counter, so [Rails 4.1.8's association counter handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rails/rails/v4.1.8/activerecord/lib/active_record/associations/has_many_association.rb) does not decrement it. This leaves the count serialized at app/serializers/basic_group_serializer.rb:2 inflated, although member pagination independently obtains the actual count at app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:25.
